Usage: resecta-data build bundle-size [OPTIONS]

  Build the bundle-size instrumentation probe.

  Walks the configured ``build/`` subdirectories and writes ``instrumentation/bundle_size.json``.
  Engineer-facing only; the Swift cold-start hook ships from the Mac side.

Options:
  --build-dir DIRECTORY  [required]
  --sub-dir TEXT         Subdirectory under build/ to include. Repeat to add more; defaults to the
                         shipping-asset scope.  [default: context, gazetteers, rules, vectors]
  --help                 Show this message and exit.
